objective: Sofía receives urgent warnings from El Loro about her neighbor Tomás and decides to confront him about his suspicious behavior toward her.
hook: The parrot's intensity frightens Sofía more than usual—its agitation is unprecedented, suggesting danger far beyond what she has known.

objective: Julia discovers Sofía missing and finds El Loro distressed; she realizes her sister has vanished and the parrot is their only link to what happened.
hook: El Loro repeats Sofía's name obsessively, refuses to eat, and the cage door is mysteriously unlocked—signs pointing to something catastrophic.

objective: Detective Ramírez investigates the disappearance but dismisses Julia's story about the parrot's warnings; he notices details that intrigue him despite his skepticism.
hook: Ramírez observes bruising on Julia's arm, notices inconsistencies in the neighborhood timeline, and grows suspicious—something about this case breaks the usual pattern and demands attention.

objective: Julia brings El Loro to behavioral scientist Dr. Chen, who discovers the parrot's vocalizations contain structured patterns unlike normal bird speech and records clear instances of language.
hook: Dr. Chen's equipment captures audio of the parrot producing complex, intentional sounds—the parrot becomes evidence, not merely a pet.

objective: Ramírez and Dr. Chen set up surveillance to capture El Loro's communications while investigating Tomás, who begins destroying evidence and acting nervously.
hook: Surveillance video shows Tomás leaving his house at night with bags, attempting to flee; Ramírez's suspicion crystallizes into certainty.

objective: Under interrogation, Tomás's story crumbles when confronted with contradictions about his whereabouts on the night Sofía vanished.
hook: El Loro's voice suddenly echoes through the police station via recording—a sound Tomás recognizes—and his composure shatters as he realizes he has been caught.

objective: El Loro's recorded phrase matches a confession Tomás made weeks ago, captured incidentally on audio; the parrot's evidence becomes incontrovertible proof.
hook: Tomás breaks down and reveals where Sofía was taken; time is running out to reach her alive.

objective: Using Tomás's confession as a guide, the team finds Sofía; El Loro reunites with its owner, restoring voice to the voiceless and truth to the world.
hook: Sofía recovers; she can hear El Loro again, and its story is finally believed by everyone—the bond that saved her is now celebrated rather than hidden.
